_help: ~/.pypirc, read by twine and other PyPI uploaders. Each host is an index's upload host: upload.pypi.org ([pypi]), test.pypi.org ([testpypi]) or a private index (its own section, with a repository URL). For a PyPI API token the user is __token__ and the token is the password. Installing (pip, uv) reads ~/.netrc instead: use the netrc target for a private index. This file stores ENV VAR NAMES, not secrets. Writes MERGE into an existing .pypirc, keeping every other section.
